publicationRules: Keep records as distinct source rows even when numbers, titles, or amounts repeat; retain attachment URL and row fingerprint.
Only display a value as verified after checking the original document, its jurisdiction, fiscal period, line item, and units.
Never aggregate a barangay budget into the municipal budget or attribute Rizal/provincial values to Pililla.
Keep zero, not reported, not found, inaccessible, and not applicable as different states.
